newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-ALBERTINI SUGGESTS ITALY VISIT AUSCHWITZ.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ALBERTINI SUGGESTS ITALY VISIT AUSCHWITZ.

text.p: Milan midfielder Demetrio Albertini said on Friday that he hoped Italy would be able to make a symbolic visit to the former Nazi death camp of Auschwitz before a World Cup qualifier in Poland next month.
The suggestion of such a visit was first raised by players' union head Sergio Campana.
Albertini said he backed it although he recognised the schedule might not allow sufficient time.
"Personally, I find the suggestion very interesting," he was quoted as saying in the Gazzetta dello Sport. "Visiting Auschwitz would have an extraordinary symbolic significance."
Italy are due to play Poland in Chorzow on April 2 after another qualifier against Moldova at the end of March.
Auschwitz, where the Nazis killed 1.5 million people, the vast majority of them Jews, is about 40 km from the Italian team's base in Poland.
